create_pose_from_Rt: create a Pose object from a rotation matrix and translation vector tensor
create_pose_from_4x4mat: create a Pose object from a 4x4 SE3 transformation matrix tensor
compose_poses: compose two SE3 Pose objects to chain coordinate frame transformations

create_camera_from_dict: create a Camera object from a COLMAP camera dictionary or named tuple
